Product Features

  • Total dimensions: 140 x 40 x 65 cm, perfect for a living room corner. The modular design with three vertical columns creates a clutter-free, organized space without taking up too much space.
  • Stylish and elegant: The high-gloss front provides a clean, elegant look. The fresh, classy white of the cabinet adds a modern touch to any living room and blends seamlessly into any décor.
  • Versatile storage options: Two doors and three drawers are perfect for bulky items, while adjustable dividers offer a variety of storage options. The upper level provides a large, flat surface for frequently used items, making it suitable for all storage situations.
  • Smart LED ambience: The LED light strip, which can be controlled via an app, adjusts the colour and brightness for an impressive experience when watching films or providing a warm light in everyday life. This way, the sideboard creates the perfect atmosphere in your living room.
  • High-gloss surface: The front is high-gloss and provides an elegant, easy-to-clean appearance. It brings order to your living room and adds a touch of simple, modern flair to your lifestyle.
  • Practical structure: The cabinet door is divided into two internal levels, each with adjustable dividers for convenient organization and ample storage space.
  • Minimalist style: The clean and elegant white design blends seamlessly into modern Nordic interiors, combining beauty with functionality.
  • Load capacity and quality: This cabinet has a recommended load capacity of 50 kg. Bottom-mounted rails and soft-close hinges ensure smooth opening and closing of the doors and drawers, ensuring durability, stability and safety.
  • Built-in functionality: This design combines storage, presentation, and ambiance—from convenient storage and beautiful display to smart lighting—to enhance the quality of living in your living room.
  • Note: This product comes in two packages and can therefore be delivered with a time delay. Please make sure both packages have arrived before assembling!

Descriptions

Descriptions

Measuring 140 x 40 x 65 cm, this sideboard perfectly combines functionality and style and offers more storage space in your living room. It is decorated in white and has two doors, three drawers and adjustable dividers. This sideboard combines functionality and elegance, enhancing your personal style and adding a touch of freshness to your living space! The high-gloss surface is easy to clean and visually appealing. The shelves can be infinitely adjusted and offer space for items of different sizes. The sideboard is sturdy and durable and has a recommended load capacity of 50 kg. USB Power Delivery: Included is a 5V 2A USB cable (USB port not included) for connecting to TVs, computers, power banks, and more. Safe and practical for indoor use. App application and manager: 1. iOS and Android systems can download the "LotusLantern" app by scanning the QR code. To do this, open a browser or other tool with the "Scan QR Code" feature and scan the "LotusLantern" QR code (the QR code is in the user manual). 2. Click on the LotusLantern app icon to open the app page. 3. If Bluetooth is not enabled in the app interface, you will see the message "An application wants to enable the Bluetooth function of this device". Click 'Allow.' 4. Simply stick the light strip to a clean, dry surface with the self-adhesive backing. Use the included tape to improve adhesion. Please test the LED light strips before installation and install them carefully. If you have any questions, please contact us.
